implementation_scope.note: 本表提供54种原型的可解析分级参数；原M01–M36保持既有等级机制，新M37–M54的等级条目延长反击窗口，所选难度额外机制由enemy_ability_catalog提供。行为执行、场景交互与美术各自验收，数据存在不代表完整玩法已交付。

encounter_rules.total_count_formula: [6,6,7][zone_index] + biome_index - 1 + difficulty; natural actors across every batch, excluding summons
encounter_rules.initial_slots: 5 at B01/B02 difficulty 0-1; 6 at B03/B04 or difficulty 2-4; shared with summon reservations and limited by threat
encounter_rules.source: one distinct reference_wave specialist per batch, plus biome-specific light reinforcement pools; all waves are explicit and finite
encounter_rules.room_cap_semantics: 18 concurrently occupied seats including summon reservations, not total kills over sequential waves

parameter_contract.units: seconds / world units / degrees; all arrays are locked at tell start
parameter_contract.tier_merge: base parameters then tier2..4 replacement patches; no repeated unbounded tier stacking
parameter_contract.tell_seconds: >= catalog minimum_tell_seconds; ground area attacks also require area_tell_seconds>=0.8
parameter_contract.combo_gap_seconds: >=0.55; each numbered segment must show its own full tell
parameter_contract.max_active_hazards: owner cap; M11<=2, M33<=2, old effects retire before new activation
parameter_contract.support_charges: finite lifetime charge budget; no support-to-support heal/guard loops
parameter_contract.path_mode: authored finite movement pattern; must use room collision/navigation
parameter_contract.elite: explicit rank, no automatic promotion from enemy level; ceil(base*1.5) before tier cost; M36 replaces aftershock with one 95-unit ring, a safe gap of at least 50 degrees, and a fuse of at least 1.6 seconds
